items.quote: In the approaches to Mumbai (Bombay), Western Arm of the TSS has been established to assist mariners to navigate safely in the vicinity of the previously-described Offshore Oil Development Areas. items.head: Caution

Heavy smog and haze may reduce the visibility in the harbor. It was reported (2001) that heavy pollution and siltation in the harbor prevented the vessel’s depth finder from giving accurate readings.
